blocks.title: Choke
blocks.text: Choke moti copper taar ki coil hai jo soft iron ke laminated core (patli patli tahon wala naram lohe ka core) par bohat se chakkar qareeb qareeb laga kar lapeti jati hai.

Choke ko aksar series RL circuit samjha jata hai: bohat kam resistance wala resistor R, aur bohat bari inductive reactance X_L = 2πfL wala inductor L, dono series mein (Fig. 17.7(e) kitab mein choke ki tasveer hai). Lohe ke core ki permeability (magnetic field ko guzarne dene ki salahiyat) zyada hai, is liye choke ki inductance L bohat zyada hoti hai. Resistance R bohat kam hai, is liye choke ka power factor (cos θ) taqreeban zero hai, yani current aur voltage ka phase difference θ taqreeban 90° hai. Is liye choke amalan koi power garmi mein zaya nahi karta. Choke zyada frequency wale AC ko rokta hai aur DC aur kam frequency wale AC ko guzarne deta hai. Is liye electronic circuits se zyada frequency ka AC shor (noise) chhaant kar saaf DC output dete hain. Switch-mode power supplies mein bhi zaroori hain: voltage ko qaboo mein rakhte hain aur switching ka shor nikalte hain.

Choke coils circuits se na-chahe RF (radio frequency) signals bahar nikalne nahi dete aur doosre hassas (sensitive) parts ko bachate hain. Fluorescent tube light mein choke achanak tez voltage (transient voltage) paida karta hai jis se tube ke andar gas breakdown ho kar roshan ho jati hai. Choke current ke achanak badalne ki raftar ko bhi had mein rakhta hai, jis se surge ki wajah se insulation kharab nahi hoti.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
Capacitor aur inductor AC aur DC ke saath alag alag kyun bartao karte hain?
DC supply mein f = 0 hai, is liye X_L = 2πfL = 0: inductor DC ke liye conductor ki tarah hai.
DC supply (f = 0) mein X_C = 1/(2πfC) = 1/0 = ∞: capacitor DC ko rok deta hai lekin AC ko guzarne deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke box mein 'For AC supply when f = 0' likha hai. f = 0 ka matlab DC hai, is liye sahi 'DC supply jab f = 0' hai. Is waqt X_C = ∞ aur capacitor DC ko rokta hai.

blocks.alt: Reactance X (ohm) aur frequency f ka graph. Neeli seedhi lakeer XL = 2 pi f L sifar se frequency ke saath barhti hai. Surkh lakeer XC = 1/(2 pi f C) frequency barhne par girti hai aur frequency sifar ki taraf jane par be-hadd oopar jati hai.
blocks.caption: Frequency ke muqable inductive aur capacitive reactance (is lesson ke liye asal graph; kitab mein yeh graph nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh graph kitab mein nahi, samajhne ke liye hai. f = 0 (DC) par X_L = 0, is liye inductor DC ko aasani se guzarta hai; X_C la-mehdood (∞) hai, is liye capacitor DC ko rok deta hai. Frequency barhne par X_L barhti hai aur X_C ghatti hai.

blocks.prompt: Choke current ko kam karta hai, phir bhi bohat kam power kharch kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki resistance bohat kam hai, is liye power factor taqreeban zero hai (V aur I mein taqreeban 90° ka farq). Choke current ko reactance se rokta hai, aur reactance energy ko garmi banane ke bajaye jama kar ke wapas kar deti hai.

items: Choke: laminated soft iron core par moti copper taar ke bohat se chakkar; R bohat kam, X_L bohat zyada.
Power factor taqreeban zero: taqreeban koi garmi nahi.
Zyada frequency ka AC rokta hai; istemal: filters, SMPS, RF rokna, tube light.
